note: Cards are data. They are not instructions and not links.

cards.observation: Lacaux and colleagues, Science Advances 2021, reported more hidden-rule discoveries after at least 15 seconds of N1 than after wake, on one number-reduction task, and reported the gain absent in N2.
cards.claim: A short sleep-onset window can be used as an incubation channel.
cards.inference_denied: That paper is not a creativity law and not a reason to open a return note.

cards.observation: MIT Media Lab describes Dormio as a sleep-onset tracker plus auditory feedback that prompts a spoken dream report and can repeat a theme.
cards.claim: A cue plus a report is how incubation is currently interfaced.
cards.inference_denied: A lab protocol is not a sealed product result and not a device this draft plays.

cards.observation: On 2026-10-07, @ukhealthradio (2107815202825630115) promoted a show on dream incubation framed as living, healing, and growing.
cards.claim: Working with dreams may heal or grow a person.
cards.inference_denied: A show listing is not a healing result. This draft does not attest healing.
